about: The Sefirot of Lord of the Mysteries: sources of power and authority, each gathering the
Uniquenesses of a group of neighbouring pathways. A being who holds a Sefirah and every one of
its group's Uniquenesses is a Great Old One, Above the Sequence.
The program reads this file but never writes it; edit it by hand like pathways.json.
A character's sefirahId in characters.json is the id of the Sefirah they hold.
Facts come from the novels and the Lord of the Mysteries wiki; notes say what is sequel lore or a guess.

sefirot.name: Sefirah Castle
alsoKnownAs: The palace above the gray fog
sefirot.description: An ancient castle floating above an endless gray fog. Whoever controls it can pull others' spirit bodies into it, hear prayers addressed to it and keep what happens there hidden from divination. Klein Moretti met the Tarot Club there. It is one of the Pillar-level Sefirot.
knownHolders: Klein Moretti, the Fool, who controls it from the start of the story to its end

sefirot.name: Chaos Sea
sefirot.description: A sea of chaos left by the Original Creator, the source of matter and energy. It is the only Sefirah that merges the real and the illusory and can be entered from the physical world. It is one of the Pillar-level Sefirot.
knownHolders: The Primordial God Almighty (the Original Creator), its first holder
The Ancient Sun God, who inherited it and rose Above the Sequence
Adam, who drew on it after fusing with the True Creator (about Ch. 1375) to become a Half Great Old One for a time

sefirot.name: River of Eternal Darkness
sefirot.description: A river of darkness with many tributaries, running through the underworld where the dead go. With the City of Calamity it is one of the two symbols of the hidden Fourth Pillar.

sefirot.name: City of Calamity
sefirot.description: With the River of Eternal Darkness it is one of the two symbols of the hidden Fourth Pillar. Its will is called the Malevolent Dragon.

sefirot.name: Knowledge Moor
sefirot.description: The Sefirah of knowledge, sought by the Hermit and Paragon pathways.

sefirot.name: Key of Light
sefirot.description: The Sefirah of the Wheel of Fortune pathway. Its will, called the Golden Buddha, was never shattered.

sefirot.name: Brood Hive
sefirot.description: The Sefirah of the Mother and Moon pathways. Its will is called the Unborn Ancient Mother, and part of the Mother Goddess of Depravity's Sefirah was torn away into it.

sefirot.name: Tenebrous World
sefirot.description: The Sefirah of the Abyss and Chained pathways.

sefirot.name: Nation of Disorder
sefirot.description: The Sefirah of the Black Emperor and Justiciar pathways. It corrupted the Justiciar Uniqueness, which became the Trunsoest Brass Book. Its will is called the Celestial Thearch.
